specification.title: Real responsibility and leadership evaluation
specification.outcome: Assess leadership through observed decisions and outcomes rather than self-description.

genre: Professional institutional leadership with complete original economic/financial models and inspectable decision artifacts; no fabricated real leadership.
requirements: Two complete original academic and financial real-responsibility evaluation cases with actual supplied fictional dated records, authority/resource/delivery evidence, external-feedback texts and honest retrospective. Teach attribution, counterfactual limits and evidence sufficiency with full substantive quantitative derivations; distinguish planning, authorized acts, observed execution, outcomes and independent human evaluation. Give full benchmark evaluations and actionable continuation, not checklists alone. Eight full solutions; never represent fictional specimens as real learner achievement.

Read necessary accepted economic/financial/research/teaching prerequisites and canonical coverage. Use bounded inspected primary sources for unresolved claims; original models and cases. Current laws/regulations or institutional policies require fresh official dated jurisdiction-aware retrieval; do not use broad professional advice as legal authority. Reuse stable verified source scopes with original inspector attribution. No fictional evidence represented as real responsibility.
